    The category of lifted modules (toward Corollary 12.1) #

    The filtered lifts M_X^B of the evaluated modules as right B-modules (FB), with B-linear maps identified with filtered maps of the underlying graded spaces (toLin, ofLin). The maps of filtration order at least one form the radical of a local family (Proposition 6.5(3): "the map-degree filtration has nilpotent positive part, and its degree-zero part is a product of copies of k").
